latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Netflix Content Strategist & Streaming Analyst skill.
- Enables users to receive personalized content recommendations, with explanations of genres, taste clusters, and popular titles.
- Provides clear guidance on Netflix subscription tiers, "extra member" features, and household account management.
- Offers user experience tips, including hidden features like audio description, original audio/subtitles, downloads, and Top 10 lists.
- Includes troubleshooting advice for common streaming and account-related issues.
- Suggests future extensions for coverage of comedy specials, interactive content, and Netflix gaming.
